REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION
TUESDAY - JANUARY 13, 2026 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Community Development Department, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 2nd floor, Cerritos, CA, 90703 during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the Commission after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection at the Community Development Department during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to economic_development@cerritos.gov or by phone at (562) 916-1201 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The Commission, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item. Public comment on Consent Calendar and non-agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 5.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to economic_development@cerritos.gov or by hard copy to the Community Development Department no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the Commission prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact City of Cerritos ADA/504 Coordinator, Drew Schneider, at (562) 916-1314 at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

CITY OF CERRITOS

  MINUTES

Regular Economic Development Commission Meeting
January 13, 2026
City Council Chambers
18125 Bloomfield Ave
Cerritos, California 90703

PRESENT:  Commissioner Kenneth Chiang
  Commissioner Aris Tagle
  Vice Chair Grace Hu
  Chair Alfred Reyes Jr.

PRESENT:  Deputy City Manager/Acting Director of Community Development Ryan Carey
  Theater Executive Director Jeff Thielke
  Director of Public Works/City Engineer Alvin Papa
  Assistant Director of Public Works Chris Kuebert
  Economic Development Manager Kiana Miranda
  Marketing Administrator Glenn Arnade

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Chair Reyes

3.  Roll Call

  All Members of the Economic Development Commission were declared present
  except Commissioner Hews, who was noted absent and excused by a majority
  consensus of the Economic Development Commission.

4.  Presentations

  Informational report providing a status update on water and sewer infrastructure,
  including an emergency repair of the C-4 well and the purchase of imported water.

  A brief staff report was given by Director of Public Works/City Engineer Alvin Papa
  and Assistant Director of Public Works Chris Kuebert. A PowerPoint presentation was
  displayed, providing details about the City of Cerritos’ current water and sewer
  infrastructure needs, the emergency repair of the C-4 Well, and the approximate
  cost of imported water.

  Discussion continued with the Commission regarding the service life of the C-4
  Well, funds allocated to the repair of equipment, the cost associated with
  importing water, the current conditions of the remaining three (3) Wells, and the
  concern that the emergency repair of the C-4 Well may take longer than
  anticipated. The Economic Development Commission received and filed the
  report.

 5.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Chair Reyes invited comments and suggestions from the public on items not listed on
  the agenda. Seeing and hearing no one wishing to address the Economic
  Development Commission, Chair Reyes closed public comments.

6.  Consent Calendar

6A.  Approval of Minutes

  Tuesday, December 9, 2025, 7:00 p.m. Economic Development Commission Regular
  Meeting Minutes.

  MOTION: It was moved by Commissioner Tagle, and seconded by Vice Chair Hu, to
  approve the Tuesday, December 9, 2025, 7:00 p.m. Economic Development
  Commission Regular Meeting Minutes.

  The motion carried (4-0-1-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chiang, Tagle, Hu, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Hews
  ABSTAIN:  None

7.  New and Old Business

7A.  Review and consideration of an informational report regarding apprenticeship
  programs provided by Cerritos College Division of Continuing Education.

  A brief introduction was given by Economic Development Manager Kiana Miranda. A
  presentation was given by Cerritos College Division of Continuing Education
  Instructional Dean of Continuing Education, Dr. Graciela Vasquez, and Program
  Facilitator, Claudia Aguilar-Gonzalez, providing details about the apprenticeship
  opportunities at Cerritos College, resources for underrepresented groups, and the
  pending approval of career advancement for participants.

  Discussion continued with the Commission regarding established partnerships
  with Cerritos businesses and the Cerritos College Division of Continuing
  Education Apprenticeship Program, the program's success rate, and the cost of
  attending the Cerritos College Apprenticeship Program.

7B.  Review and consideration of an informational report regarding Economic
  Development updates on the City of Cerritos, including grand opening events,
  building permit activity, and on-going development projects.

  A staff report was given by Economic Development Manager Kiana Miranda. A
  PowerPoint presentation was displayed, providing details on current development
  projects and commercial and industrial improvements, including grand opening
  events, demonstrating the City’s role in facilitating business attraction,
  expansion, and retention.

  Discussion continued with the Commission regarding the marketing strategy for
  current business development, the most common delays in permit issuance, and the

City of Cerritos  J anuary 13, 2026
Economic Development Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 2
   City’s involvement in development at the Los Cerritos Center. The Economic
  Development Commission received and filed the report.

7C.  Review and consideration of a request by the Economic Development
  Commission to discuss a potential summer activation concept at Cerritos Towne
  Center.

  A staff report was given by Economic Development Manager Kiana Miranda. A
  PowerPoint presentation was displayed, providing details about the Commission’s
  consensus request that the City explore a potential summer activation concept
  at Cerritos Towne Center, including the possibility of limited, early-evening live
  music programming. Ms. Miranda continued her presentation by providing the
  approximate cost per event, the production and technical support needed,
  budget considerations, and the alignment of the discussed summer activation
  concept with the City of Cerritos Strategic Plan, Goal #4 – Strengthen Economic
  Development.

  Discussion continued with the Commission regarding the Commission’s role in
  accordance with Policy No. 6.02 “Commission and Committee Scope of Authority
  Policy” of the City Policy and Procedure Manual, the request to promote patron
  activity in the City of Cerritos, the potential postponement of the summer
  activation concept to fiscal year 2026-2027, and the potential revenue from the
  potential activation.

  MOTION: It was moved by Chair Reyes and seconded by Commissioner Chiang to
  provide a specific scope (advisory only) for a Commission-initiated special project to
  further explore a potential summer activation concept at Cerritos Towne Center and
  approve the transmittal of a request for authorization to the City Council per Policy
  6.02.

  The motion carried (4-0-1-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chiang, Tagle, Hu, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Hews
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Reports

8A.  Reports from Designated Commission Liaison

  Economic Development Manager Kiana Miranda reported that the Commission
  received written correspondence regarding item 5A.

8B.  Reports from Planning Commission Members

  Reports were given by Commissioner Chiang, Commissioner Tagle, Vice Chair Hu,
  and Chair Reyes.

9.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 8:59 p.m.
